source: Google Business Profile, High Quality Clean Ltd (public reviews)
note: Snapshot of the public profile. Review text is verbatim; reviewers are shown by first name and last initial; written reviews rated 4 or 5 stars are displayed. Rating-only reviews are not shown, because their only text is HQC's reply.

reviews.name: Anne K.
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience from start to finish. Pedro was incredibly attentive, professional and responsive throughout the whole process, making everything really easy.

The team did a fantastic job with the deep clean as well as our upholstery cleaning, and they were so accommodating around our curious kitten, which we really appreciated. Nothing felt like too much trouble, and the attention to detail was outstanding.

We genuinely can't recommend them highly enough and will absolutely be using Pedro and the team again. They ticked every box – an exceptional service all round!

reviews.name: Thomas B.
reviews.text: High quality clean has some very high quality people working with them. This team of 3 that I met - Pedro, Uya and Shahn made it their upmost priority to not only provide the best service possible in keeping the facilities clean at Lowlu Sauna Wandsworth but also handling customer issues such as my access code not working. Great all round

reviews.name: Daisy T.
reviews.text: These guys are amazing! My house is transformed - they did an excellent job. Would 100% recommend.

reviews.name: Asena Y.
reviews.text: We needed a cleaner for our move-out and the service was excellent. Responded to me very quickly, and had them booked within a day! They did such a thorough job and left the place looking immaculate. Would absolutely recommend to anyone needing a reliable cleaner.

reviews.name: Neylan C.
reviews.text: Pedro and his team came highly recommended by a family friend. Having worked with professional cleaning companies in the past ending with disappointing results, I was initially quite skeptical. My experience was far from disappointing to say the least. Pedro’s care and attention to detail exceeded my expectations. It is very rare these days to receive great customer care/service and a job well done - both of which Pedro and his team delivered. I would highly recommend anyone who wants a smooth process and a very clean home to contact Pedro and book an appointment as soon as possible.

reviews.name: 赵孟洵
reviews.text: They cleaned very carefully, although it took longer than expected, but also didn't just clean up quickly and go away, I think it was a very good experience.

reviews.name: Courtney O.
reviews.text: I recently hired Pedro from High Quality Clean for a deep clean with short notice, and he exceeded my expectations. Pedro was incredibly professional, and paid attention to every detail. He explained to me along the way how he normally cleans, and which products are best to use. Pedro was friendly, thorough, and worked efficiently focusing on the areas of the house I had highlighted. I have had a few cleaning services in the past, but this experience was by far the best. Highly recommended and I will be using Pedro again.

reviews.name: Jennifer T.
reviews.text: Pedro and his team did an amazing job cleaning my bathroom - reasonable price and they worked incredibly hard - it feels like a brand new bathroom! Thank you High Quality Clean Ltd!

reviews.name: Elena K.
reviews.text:
Wonderful cleaning service! Highly recommend! Quick, efficient and excellent quality!
I called Pedro in the morning to arrange professional cleaning of a property on the same day and Pedro managed to come to our place and commenced the cleaning just in few hours. He did absolutely amazing job all over the property leaving our place spotless. He is very knowledgeable guy too and enthusiastically gave us few tips here and there about best way to clean.
I will certainly use his service again and will recommend to friends.

reviews.name: Debbie
reviews.text: Mary was amazing, really kind and warm, my bathroom is now spotless!! I would 100% recommend using this company and will be booking in my next clean ASAP!

reviews.name: Sippin’ S.
reviews.text: WOW thank you all so incredibly much!! I don’t think I’ve ever seen our house so clean! You guys have done such a fabulous job! Thank you!! 🙏 🙏🙏 can’t recommend them enough! …

reviews.name: Ozlem M.
reviews.text: My most satisfied cleaning experience. I have never worked with a cleaning company that pays so much attention to detail compared to my previous experiences. Pedro is incredibly polite and extremely respectful of his work. My experience at every stage from communication to completion of the job is 5 stars. Thank you High Quality Clean Limited. Hope to continue working with you in future.

reviews.name: Lucy M.
reviews.text: Absolutely blown away by the service and excellent standard of my deep clean. Property looks completely different thanks to the team. The standard of cleaning was exceptional and the team were a delight. 110% recommend, thank you so much!!

reviews.name: Gani D.
reviews.text: Pedro and his team have been great so far (using them for last 2 months) as we were looking for professional cleaning service for our house . High Quality Clean charges a fair rate, accepts card payments , are professional and take on feedback to ensure quality deep cleaning of the house. We had one of the cleaners changed after some feedback and are very happy with the current service and would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Luke S.
reviews.text: I used High Quality Clean for a house clean leaving my current house share and would highly recommend. The service was very thorough and the staff were really friendly. Would definitely use again.

reviews.name: Anna S.
reviews.text: Absolutely spotless! A high quality, thorough clean of my flat. The staff were really friendly and would highly recommend. Thank you again!

reviews.name: Heba W.
reviews.text:
We booked our cleaning with Pedro because of the reviews and the cost transparency on the website, we knew in advance how much it’ll cost us and what to expect.
Pedro arrived on time and did a great job with our home. We’re very happy customers and would definitely use Pedro’s services in the future.

reviews.name: Ina Q.
reviews.text: I recently had builders in the house and everything was dusty and also the house needed a bit of cleaning before hand. Pedro and Corey were very amazing and coordinated the different parts of the flat to each other. I was very happy with how well they cleaned the flat. They were very professional and positive through out all the experience. Defined recommended them to family and friends and use their services again.

reviews.name: Paul C.
reviews.text: Brilliant cleaning company expertly run by the owner, Pedro. He and his team do excellent work and Pedro physically oversees all the work of his team resulting in a sparkling clean home. Well done Pedro! Keep up the excellent work….and Thank You for your care and attention to detail.

reviews.name: 方澍
reviews.text: I am extremely satisfied with the services provided by High Quality Clean. They spent nearly eight hours cleaning my room, and the results were exceptionally clean. I was impressed by their efficiency and the quality of their work. Furthermore, their pricing is very reasonable. I would highly recommend the services of High Quality Clean to others. Once again, thank you for their outstanding job!

reviews.name: Angela A.
reviews.text:
Really professional and meticulous cleaning service. I was impressed by the dedication of Pedro in particular,  even returning for a second day to get the job done!!
The house was left extremely clean and I highly recommend this company.

reviews.name: Jason N.
reviews.text: High Quality Clean Ltd provided us with exceptional cleaning services. The staff were professional and friendly. They went above and beyond to ensure our complete satisfaction. Their attention to detail is unmatched, and they consistently leave my premises sparkling clean. I highly recommend their services to anyone in need of a reliable and high-quality cleaning service. Thank you, High Quality Clean Ltd, for consistently delivering excellent results.

reviews.name: Alexandra S.
reviews.text: Phenomenal cleaners. I wish I had discovered these guys sooner. From the first email exchange through to the extremely high standards of their cleaning work, I was so impressed. They saved me a lot of stress on my move out clean, but would also recommend them for more frequent cleans. Thank you Pedro and team!

reviews.name: Kara O.
reviews.text: The team do an excellent job of cleaning our house each week as well as doing special cleanings (eg deep cleans, curtains, etc) for a reasonable price. They are courteous and work around our large dog and toddler. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Steven O.
reviews.text: Pedro, the owner combines an extremely customer-driven meticulous approach to each customer. He deals with everyone he works with a directness and respect that makes his client’s feel truly understood in line with their individual requirements increasing his ability to provide an exceptional service. He couples this by working tirelessly to achieve high standards making sure he meets and exceeds his customer’s expectations. As someone that’s seen him and his team in action, I personally highly recommend him as your go-to for exceptional cleaning services, you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.name: Myreete S.
reviews.text: They are awesome! I won’t lie, I wasn’t 100% sure if this was a real service but I was so pleasantly surprised!! They were AWESOME! They cleaned the heck out of my house and now we have them back regularly. Even great for a deep deep clean.

reviews.name: C -.
reviews.text: Can’t recommend enough. Easy booking process with full cost transparency, via the website. Communication was fantastic from start to finish. Pedro even sent me a video after the clean as I wasn’t able to be there for it. Great value for money for a brilliant job. Thankyou

reviews.name: Chris M.
reviews.text: Fantastic service! The team was professional, thorough, and efficient. Our space has never looked better—everything was spotless and fresh. Great attention to detail and very friendly staff. Highly recommend!

Wow! Pedro is honestly amazing, perfect and spotless. Our two bed Meze flat was deep cleaned for our end of tenancy. Bathroom, kitchen, windows,
Sitting room and two double bedrooms. Highly recommend. I’ve never booked a cleaner before and definitely will book Pedro again.

reviews.name: Amy Q.
reviews.text: Pedro was superb. He came extremely last minute, brought every equipment/machinery necessary and did such a thorough job in a reasonable amount of time. A very polite, friendly and professional clear who we will now make our main weekly cleaner!! Thanks again Pedro!!
